Item 2.01 Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets.

On February 27, 2026, the Company completed the previously announced separation of Zeta NewCo Inc. through a pro rata distribution. In the distribution, for every three (3) shares of Zeta Parent common stock held, the Company’s shareholders received one (1) share of Zeta NewCo common stock.

Based on the closing price in the when-issued market, the value of the distribution was $14.25 per share of Zeta Parent common stock. Zeta NewCo common stock closed at $42.75 per share of Zeta NewCo common stock.
